policy: Every section 16 geometry and edge case maps to a golden scene, or to a documented reason it is not a golden scene (public API gap, or covered by an existing dedicated test).

front_back_face.note: front_face_hit and back_face_hit record geo_n from both sides (identical +z geometric normal is frozen as-is).

shared_edge_vertex.note: Strict rays sit unambiguously inside one triangle; exact edge/vertex rays are tagged informative because the winner is traversal-order defined.

degenerate_triangle.note: Zero-area triangle produces a clean miss with no NaN (frozen via nan_flags); the valid triangle hits correctly.

self_intersection.note: Origin exactly on a triangle; drjit tmin=1e-3 swallows the self hit so the +z ray reports the parallel triangle at t=0.5.

id_mapping.note: Frozen invariant global_prim_id == mesh_face_offsets()[shape_id] + local_prim_id via id_mapping_ok.

ignore_primitive.note: Includes an ignore list with more than eight entries.

empty_or_large_batch.note: Batch of 1, a 4096-ray grid, and a 0-size batch whose current behavior (RuntimeError) is frozen.

finite_infinite_ray.note: ray_finite_segment uses a finite tmax; ray_infinite leaves tmax unset.

boundary_edge.note: point_near_boundary_edge yields is_boundary=1; point_near_internal_edge yields is_boundary=0.

equal_distance_tie.note: Two edges symmetric about the query point; tie-dependent winner ids are tagged informative because drjit has no id tie-break, distances stay strict.

instance.rationale: The public RayD API exposes no instancing. Scene.add_mesh flattens each mesh into scene-global geometry and there is no per-instance transform or instance id to query, so there is no observable instance behavior to freeze.

mask_update.rationale: set_edge_mask + sync is exercised by an existing dedicated edge-BVH test across all edge backends; it is stateful and out of scope for the forward-value golden suite.

edge_dynamic_refit.rationale: Edge query after update_mesh_vertices + sync is exercised by the same existing edge-BVH test.

edge_vjp_jvp.reference: tests/scene/test_geometry_jit.py (vertex/transform gradient tests) and the P0 NumericPolicy/AD deliverable
edge_vjp_jvp.rationale: The golden suite freezes forward discrete and continuous query values only; fixed-winner VJP/JVP gradients are frozen by the existing AD gradient tests.
